# Vendor snapshots (example 08 only)

These crates are **standalone frozen copies** of clove1db at older releases. They exist only so `example_08_inspect_upgrade` can seed era fixtures without pulling the full git repository (which includes invalid example package names that confuse Cargo).

| Crate | Version | Git rev |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `clove1db-v042` | 0.0.42 | `61e9b48f489061e77ce1aad80276a550cd6d659a` |
| `clove1db-v049` | 0.0.49 | `a31e5d12fbc3a8ac1428b4d29df1987f3b144863` |

Not part of the main library workspace. Do not import from other examples.
